sloka: इयम् धार्मिक कौसल्या मम माता यशस्विनी ।वृद्धा च अक्षुद्र शीला च न च त्वाम् देव गर्हिते ॥२-३८-१५॥
transliteration: iyam dhārmika kausalyā mama mātā yaśasvinī ।vṛddhā ca akṣudra śīlā ca na ca tvām deva garhite ॥2-38-15॥

translations.english: O righteous father O king my aged and illustrious mother, Kausalya possesses neither a mean character nor does she blame you.
